purpose: Official rural due-diligence source expansion. No site-specific result is asserted until the candidate geometry or title is joined to the source record.

sources.coverage: public footpaths, bridleways, restricted byways and byways open to all traffic in Warwickshire
sources.binding_limit: The online image is not itself the legal Definitive Map and may not show all rights. A property search or authoritative extract is needed for a definitive site answer.

sources.coverage: property-specific searches of the list of streets and Definitive Map and Statement
sources.binding_limit: A site-specific search must be requested and returned; merely discovering the service does not prove whether a candidate is affected by a right of way.

sources.coverage: post-1988 Agricultural Land Classification survey polygons for England
sources.binding_limit: Coverage reflects surveyed polygons and does not guarantee that every candidate has a post-1988 detailed survey. General published grade descriptions must not be converted into parcel-specific grades without a geometry join.

sources.coverage: registration and maintenance of agricultural land parcels, permanent boundaries, land cover and hedgerows in the Rural Payments service
sources.binding_limit: The service is account and holding based; public guidance does not expose a candidate parcel boundary or establish legal ownership. RPA field numbers must not be treated as Land Registry title identifiers.
